title: Asteroid Bennu study finds nucleic bases

tellings.quote: if they did that study of that um asteroid Bennu.

plain: A scientific study of Bennu, an asteroid, is said to have found nucleic bases, the chemical building blocks of the genetic material in living things. Eric Haseltine, introduced on the show as a former director at the NSA, the US intelligence agency that listens in on electronic signals, mentions the study only in passing and does not say who did it. He raises it because, if true, life's raw ingredients would be floating around in space.
